name: Algebra 1 Practice Course Profile
role: Course-specific Practice behavior. Practice 1 is canonical Bank content; Extra/CYU/middle practice are generated during Practice build.
question_structure_rule: Use current universal Question Structure for all authored Practice questions.

practice_1.balance_rule: True balance across Intro / Review / Mastery. Equal counts when practical; otherwise difference <= 1. Do not let current Intro or current Mastery swallow the set.
practice_1.alignment: Intro block uses current section Intro; Review block uses exact current Review goal/stage; Mastery block uses exact current Mastery goal/stage and is informed by the Exit evidence map.

generated.extra_practice: Generate as recovery/extension from map, Practice 1, seeds, misconceptions, and Question Structure.
generated.cyu: Generate as a concise formative check from the same authorities.
